assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated transparent premium editorial medical cutout for a bright ivory paper-style business reel. Subject: a single elegant modern stethoscope, dark charcoal soft rubber tubing arranged in a graceful loose U curve, brushed stainless steel earpieces and a polished circular diaphragm. Entire instrument clearly visible, centered with ample padding in a square composition, slightly turned three-quarter view. Premium product photography mixed with refined tactile 3D editorial sculpture, physically convincing metal, subtle paper-like matte surface quality, soft neutral daylight from upper left and delicate natural shading within the object. Understated monochrome charcoal, silver and ivory only, no bright colours. Realistic correct instrument construction, no floating separate pieces. TRUE transparent background with clean antialiased alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no surrounding glow, no halo, no scene, no text, no logo, no watermark, no additional objects. Will be animated alongside an ivory open book and a minimal software window to represent school communication, doctor-led content and practical software systems.
